sections.title: 9月19日收尾阶段1：联合尺寸证据

blocks.text: 十二点重新验收并核对84个原始来源，生成纠缠、扇区gap和键关联联合图。历史 Stage1 记录中的 α=-0.10、L=80 两初态 gap 全差/均值 12.65% 属于旧 k=3 快照，不能当作当前 k=8 结果；本轮 L=80 k=8 两点已终态成功并通过独立验收，α=-0.10 新 gap≈7.2772×10⁻⁵、α=-0.175 新 gap≈1.5871×10⁻⁴。当前 648 条对照仍为 audit_only，物理稳定性未宣称。

items.caption: 已验收数据的尺寸比较。颜色区分α。a：十类截距拟合；线为固定f=0.20窗口的双初态均值，阴影及竖线覆盖全部四窗口和双初态。b：晶胞数N乘Sz扇区gap。c：中央区间内同类键跨相邻晶胞的差值RMS。d：胞间键在r/N=1/4的带符号交错连接关联。b、c的范围为双初态差异；d含左右两方向与双初态。所有范围均非统计置信区间；线仅引导视线。

blocks.text: 小扇区gap可能受到开边界低能态影响；NΔ不是体能隙外推。非零开边界键交替不自动等于自发二聚化；有限距离的小连接关联也不能排除长程有序。
下一阶段优先统一局域投影、晶胞动量和胞内谱权重机制，再决定最多两个困难点的收敛对照。不是继续加密全域相图，也尚未完成整个研究项目。

blocks.text: One-sentence argument

Replacing an even tetramer by an odd pentamer reorganizes the low-energy sector of the Heisenberg cluster chain: the positive-coupling pentamer retains an effective spin-1/2 doublet with antiferromagnetic inter-cell exchange, weak virtual-process-induced frustration and momentum-selective local excitations, whereas any additional phases in the negative-alpha sector must be decided by the ongoing finite-size, multi-diagnostic campaign rather than inherited from the tetramer phase diagram.
Provisional title
Odd-cell spin-1/2 physics and momentum-selective excitations in a pentamer Heisenberg chain
Abstract · working version

Clustered quantum magnets provide a setting in which unit-cell parity can reorganize the low-energy degrees of freedom. Complete isolated-cell diagonalization gives an even-parity S=1/2 ground-state doublet for alpha>0, an S=3/2 ground multiplet for alpha<0, and a degeneracy at alpha=0. Projecting the positive-side doublet yields J_eff/beta=0.4189–0.4396 at representative points, while second-order virtual processes generate a weak antiferromagnetic next-nearest-neighbour exchange. Finite-size diagnostics are consistent with an effective critical spin-1/2 chain, and 105 accepted positive-region records show no stable internal crossing under the stated rule. At (alpha,beta)=(0.23,0.5), L=40 and q=pi, correction-vector and time-evolution spectra agree; full-momentum maps at three representative points also pass paired time-step convergence gates. These results establish a local-multiplet and effective-chain mechanism, but do not by themselves prove a thermodynamic phase diagram. [Final negative-sector sentence pending Stages A–D.]
Results draft · evidence first

blocks.title: 1 · Local multiplet switch and positive-side effective exchange

blocks.text: The isolated pentamer has S=1/2 for alpha>0, S=3/2 for alpha<0, and an exact degeneracy at alpha=0. This is a local boundary control, not a coupled-chain phase transition. On the positive side, projection at alpha=0.14, 0.23 and 0.33 gives J_eff/beta=0.4396, 0.4318 and 0.4189, establishing antiferromagnetic coupling in the controlled weak-coupling regime.

A second-order construction over 100 positive-alpha points produces an antiferromagnetic next-nearest-neighbour coupling throughout the scan. At the controlled perturbative edge, J2_eff/J1_eff=3.95–5.19%. A three-cell validation changes the fitted spectral-error power to 3.0087–3.0141 when this term is retained, versus 2.0783–2.1861 when it is deleted. This is a quantitative correction, not evidence for a new phase by itself.

The lowest excited doublet has the opposite mirror parity and less than 4.6e-27 weight at q=pi, whereas quartet states carry 84.1–97.6% of the local inelastic weight. This is a local selection rule and must not be relabelled with tetramer-specific quasiparticle names.

The spin gap trends towards zero, correlation exponents lie at 0.95–0.98, and matched-size entanglement calibrations give c=1.0240–1.0331. Across 105 accepted records, L=40/60/80 differences show no stable sign-changing bracket. The supported statement is finite-size no-crossing evidence, not proof of one thermodynamic phase.

At alpha=0.23, beta=0.5, L=40 and q=pi, the accepted11 CV grid and TEBD share a peak at omega=0.05 and differ by 1.04% in shared-window weight. Six full-q runs at three points pass all validators and paired time-step checks; the maximum peak drift is 0.01 J1 and the maximum low-frequency weight drift is 4.32e-5.

blocks.text: Discussion · 核心解释与竞争解释

The principal difference from the reference tetramer chain is unit-cell parity. Four spin-1/2 moments can form singlet or effective integer-spin sectors; five moments leave a half-integer doublet in the positive-coupling local problem. The resulting antiferromagnetic projection, weak induced frustration and momentum filtering are therefore structural consequences of the pentamer rather than a shifted copy of the tetramer phase diagram.

The absence of an accepted positive-region crossing may indicate a common critical regime, but finite sizes and observable sensitivity remain rival explanations. Likewise, a negative-alpha momentum shift may be a crossover or Lifshitz-like line rather than a distinct phase. The final phase map therefore requires non-analytic finite-size evidence from at least two diagnostics.
